method: Same isolated MV3 Chromium browser on Intel UHD at a 2560x1440 viewport. Alternating 1.7.7 and 1.7.8 content controllers sample looping 1920x1080 VP9 60fps media for six seconds per window. The player is fully offscreen. Renderer code and settings stay constant. A separate 6fps stream verifies video demand, texture uploads, GPU passes and timestamp fallback.
limits: Callback and presentation-counter frequencies are not physical refreshes or distinct video frames. The browser and system load can vary between windows. JavaScript and GPU pixel probes do not measure physical display latency.
